title: any --worktree value but path:<primary> is denied, whatever the form
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A2 (defect N-23): the guard allows exactly the primary worktree
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-23, owner answer A2). The dispatch guard allows --worktree only with the exact value path:<primary>, the primary checkout named by JITSO_PROJECT. A name, another folder, a subfolder of the project and the id:<id>::<path> form are denied with the reason '--worktree must be path:<primary>'. The TS binary denies the line for another reason (it does not allow --build), so the reason text FAILS on TS.
